metadata.description: When true, deploy Container Apps Environment as internal-only and make app ingress internal.
When containerAppsInternal is true: subnet resource ID for the Container Apps Environment infrastructure subnet.
Enable IP filtering for the web application (when true, only allowedWebIp can access the API)
IP address allowed to access the web application API (comma-delimited CIDR format, e.g., "203.0.113.1/32,198.51.100.0/24")
Cosmos DB account name for endpoint resolution (managed identity auth)
Storage account name for endpoint resolution (managed identity auth)

resources.name: [parameters('containerAppsEnvName')]
resources.properties: [union(createObject('appLogsConfiguration', createObject('destination', 'none')), if(parameters('containerAppsInternal'), createObject('vnetConfiguration', createObject('infrastructureSubnetId', parameters('containerAppsInfrastructureSubnetId'), 'internal', true()), 'workloadProfiles', createArray(createObject('name', 'Consumption', 'workloadProfileType', 'Consumption'))), createObject()))]

ingress.ipSecurityRestrictions: [if(and(parameters('enableWebIpFiltering'), not(empty(parameters('allowedWebIp')))), createArray(createObject('name', 'AllowedIP', 'ipAddressRange', if(contains(parameters('allowedWebIp'), ','), trim(split(parameters('allowedWebIp'), ',')[0]), parameters('allowedWebIp')), 'action', 'Allow'), createObject('name', 'DenyAll', 'ipAddressRange', '0.0.0.0/0', 'action', 'Deny')), createArray())]

configuration.secrets: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'container-registry-password', 'value', listCredentials(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', parameters('containerRegistryName')), '2021-09-01').passwords[0].value), createObject('name', 'cosmos-endpoint', 'value', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts', parameters('cosmosAccountName')), '2023-04-15').documentEndpoint), createObject('name', 'storage-endpoint', 'value', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts', parameters('storageAccountName')), '2023-01-01').primaryEndpoints.blob), createObject('name', 'auth-client-id', 'value', parameters('authClientId'))), if(empty(parameters('emailSmtpPass')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'email-smtp-password', 'value', parameters('emailSmtpPass')))), if(empty(parameters('acsKeyVaultSecretName')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'acs-connection-string', 'keyVaultUrl', format('{0}secrets/{1}', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', parameters('keyVaultName')), '2022-07-01').vaultUri, parameters('acsKeyVaultSecretName')), 'identity', 'system'))))]
